finding.claim: kmctl init and kmctl update now read apm.yml and apm.lock.yaml through harnesses_found, and a non-UTF-8 apm.yml ends init with a UnicodeDecodeError traceback after it has written docs/README.md and the .okf/ starter but before the block and the first decision. read_manifest and read_lock catch YAML errors but not decode errors.

fixes.change: read_manifest raises PluginError and read_lock returns None on a UnicodeDecodeError, as on bad YAML.
read_manifest and read_lock over non-UTF-8 files refuse or read as no lock.
init over a non-UTF-8 apm.yml or apm.lock.yaml exits 0 and writes the all-three-folders block.
